description: This source file defines the IGrainFactory interface in the Orleans framework, providing methods for creating and managing references to grains of various types and keys, including GUID, long, string, and composite keys, as well as creating object references for grain observers.

classes.name: IGrainFactory
classes.description: Interface providing methods to obtain references to Orleans grains and manage object references.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Various overloads to obtain grain references by different key types and interface constraints.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a grain observer reference from an IGrainObserver object.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Methods to retrieve grains by GrainId or interface type.
